Alex: quick Q — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/452 updates validation for `max_tokens`. Should we return 400 or 422 when client sends out-of-range values? cc @Maria @Sam
Maria: my take: keep it 400 for now. We've historically used 400 for invalid params (type/range). 422 tends to be semantic errors but is confusing across clients. consistency > purity :thumbsup:
Sam: +1 for 400. Also we should clarify retry semantics in the docs: 4xx (except 429) = do not retry, 5xx/503/429 = retryable with backoff.
Priya: agree. I'd like a small error payload schema add: `error.type` enum (e.g. `invalid_param`, `rate_limit`, `server_error`) and optional `error.param`. Keep shape additive only so old clients still parse. Example we can show:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "max_tokens must be <= 2048",
    "type": "invalid_param",
    "param": "max_tokens"
  }
}
```
Alex: good. Action items: 1) docs update stating 400 for client validation; 2) add error.type enum and optional fields; 3) add tests to ensure 4xx vs 5xx semantics. Do we want an explicit `retryable` flag in the body?
Maria: I'm hesitant to add `retryable` top-level — it's derivable from status + type. But adding `retry_after` for rate limits is useful.
Sam: will add tests in PR to assert that range/type validation -> 400 and infra failures -> 5xx. I'll also add a brief note in the API contract: "Clients SHOULD NOT retry 4xx (except 429)."
Priya: I'll review the schema change. please make the new fields optional so older clients don't break. Also add a backward-compat note in the changelog.
DeployBot: docs deployed to staging: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/errors#status-codes — preview available :white_check_mark:
Alex: sweet. pinging @Priya and @Sam for final sign-off on PR #452 before merging. I'll add a short snippet to the SDK error docs showing how to handle these cases.
